verdict.rationale: MX documents an official MCP server (mx-probe-3) that would let AI agents issue natural-language commands against the platform, and marketing copy (mx-docs-27) describes enabling plain-language financial queries. However, there is no detailed documentation of the NL command set, limits, or hands-on confirmation of how well it works. Missing for 10: detailed MCP tool/command documentation, independent verification of NL command execution, and coverage of edge cases/limitations.
